m: पहाडी f. (in music) N. of a Rāgiṇī (cf. पाहाडिका).

पह्लव m. pl. N. of a people (the Parthians or Persians), Mn. x, 44; MBh. &c. (also spelt पह्नव; in the VP. they are said to be a degraded Kṣatriya race conquered by Sagara and sentenced to wear beards).
